steps.description: Single enable flag SPEC_PACK_MODE=0|1 in scratchpad (active and template), default 0.
When SPEC_PACK_MODE=0, intake, architecture, release, execute, qa add no extra required spec-pack steps (zero overhead).
When enabled, three artifacts at canonical paths: design-concept, crs, technical-specification; spec-pack README in active and template.
Minimum required sections defined in runbook and spec-pack README; completeness testable (Design Concept, CRS, Technical Spec sections).
Release step 3c validates spec-pack when enabled; blocks with SPEC_PACK_INCOMPLETE only when enabled and required sections missing.
Traceability story ID to three spec-pack artifact paths documented in runbook and spec-pack README.
Ownership (Design Concept: Tech Lead/architecture; CRS: PO/intake; Technical Spec: TL create, Dev update) in runbook.
Active and template commands, runbook, README aligned for spec-pack mode; US-0031 regression checks in run-tests.
